name: fo-corporate-income-tax
description: Prepare 2026 Faroese company tax working papers for P/F and Sp/F companies, separating ordinary income from capital gains. Check residence and the 18% rate conditions, reconcile profit, calculate equipment and building depreciation, and distinguish company interest from separately taxed investments. Track ordinary and capital losses, exempt dividends, ownership changes, distributions, group permissions, returns and payments. Use for Faroese corporation tax, investment gains, business assets, company losses, dividend withholding and incorporation or closure questions. Petroleum, fishing and aquaculture charges, tonnage tax, reorganisations, international minimum tax and treaty-specific outcomes need separate work. This Guide has been checked against the law and accepted for partial publication after independent AI review; professional attestation remains pending.
